name: GitHub Actions Response
description: Diagnose and resolve GitHub Actions or required-check failures with guarded external updates.
approval_boundaries: Do not rerun, cancel, update, merge, or bypass checks without authorization.
Do not expose workflow secrets or credentials.

phases.name: GitHub check evidence
phases.instructions: Inspect checks, rulesets, logs, and branch-protection state.

phases.name: Failure triage
phases.instructions: Identify the first actionable failure and classify likely ownership.

phases.name: Local diagnosis
phases.instructions: Reproduce locally when possible and isolate the root cause.

phases.name: Environment check
phases.instructions: Check runtime, install, cache, and lockfile drift.

phases.name: Workflow repair
phases.instructions: When evidence requires it, apply the smallest workflow or source repair.

phases.name: Independent CI review
phases.instructions: Review the failure and repair against configured gates.

phases.name: Authorized PR update
phases.instructions: Only when explicitly authorized, rerun or update the PR/check state required by the task.
phases.output: Remote action record or no-action disposition.

phases.name: CI response handoff
phases.instructions: Report cause, repair, checks, authorization, risk, and next action.
